name: 33431 · Boca Raton, FL
findings: ZIP 33431 (Boca Raton) has 263 nonprofit organizations. 85 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 71 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33431 (Boca Raton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
49% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
